contract_source.authority: User-accepted Night Dial 43-flow interaction registry; source paragraphs remain additional constraints.

purpose: Finite work/evidence register, not a design approval gate. Missing native evidence is verification work, not proof that local implementation is missing. No arbitrary future device matrix is added.

classification_definitions.implemented_functional_current_evidence: Implementation has functional assertions in latest pinned 351/538 native evidence; exact source/run/method/PNGs and covered subset are explicit. This is not a PASS for unexecuted source66.
classification_definitions.visual_only: At most family-entry/configuration rendering is evidenced; no state interaction acceptance follows. State-specific screen may not be captured.
classification_definitions.missing_local_behavior: Concrete inspected source lacks a required local interaction, with named owner/symbol and finite repair.
classification_definitions.external_physical_prerequisite: The stated action requires a real sensor, output, OS/provider, account, network or launcher prerequisite; verify the finite supported path and safe alternative, not an infinite device matrix.
classification_definitions.unsupported_model_or_contract: Complete the truthful unavailable/insufficient-data and supported-alternative contract; do not require or fabricate an unsupported measurement/service.

prioritized_local_findings.finding: Tag comparison With/Without rows pass a null action; contributing group cannot open exact filtered saved nights.
prioritized_local_findings.next_action: Add contributing-record identity/filter navigation and preserve the reviewed tagged/untagged sample definition; do not alter association calculations.

prioritized_local_findings.finding: Milestone rows have no click listener; the separate latest-seven list is not a selected milestone contribution review.
prioritized_local_findings.next_action: Make the selected reached milestone review its exact qualifying contributing nights, retaining coverage provenance; keep unsupported estimated-night creation separate.

prioritized_local_findings.finding: Named deletion cancels/deletes/finishes with no deletion Undo token. Existing Undo is skip/override only.
prioritized_local_findings.next_action: Add explicit post-delete Undo that restores the exact deleted identity/configuration once without duplication, under existing scheduling owners; no undo action in the confirmation.

prioritized_local_findings.finding: History has Trends, search/filter/date and Add actions, but no Import action required by the registry.
prioritized_local_findings.next_action: Add the explicit History → existing CSV import/reconciliation owner route, preserving History scope on Cancel/return; do not create another importer.

prioritized_local_findings.finding: The full design manual-entry constraint requires overlap review before Save; current Save validates bounds then creates a separate period without reviewing cross-record overlap.
prioritized_local_findings.next_action: Read the actual intersecting saved coverage and review the real separate-record policy before explicit Save; disclose that duration trends count overlapping coverage once. Do not invent merge/rejection semantics.

prioritized_local_findings.finding: Report has no Preview/Share system-chooser route. SleepSummaryActivity only serves a caller-owned GET_CONTENT JSON picker and always excludes notes.
prioritized_local_findings.next_action: Add an explicit Report-scoped preview and user-triggered system share route with reviewed optional content; preserve the existing public JSON picker and temporary-grant owners.
